title: Preview Images Directly in Business Central Web Client

features.name: Image Preview in Web Client
features.description: Users can now preview supported image attachments directly in the Business Central web client without downloading the file first. Images are displayed in a dedicated viewer similar to existing PDF preview experience.
features.status_evidence_quote: So a true preview experience for images is now available with version 29 and later.
caveats: Only works with supported image formats
Not yet added to incoming documents
GIF animation support limited to 48 frames

features.name: Supported Image Formats
features.description: The image preview experience supports JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP, SVG, WEBP, ICO, GIF, and AVIF formats. GIF and AVIF support includes animated versions. TIFF and TIFF images are also supported only on Safari browsers.

features.name: File View From Stream Method
features.description: For Business Central online, developers should use the new FileViewFromStream method to load files into a stream and display preview. This replaces the older FileDownload approach and provides UCI compliance.
caveats: OnPrem developers should use FileViewFromStream instead of the older FileView method to avoid UCI compliance issues

features.name: Document Attachment Preview
features.description: Document attachments now support image preview through a view action that displays the image output directly in the client without downloading.
caveats: Feature not yet added to incoming documents

features.name: Image Preview Across Business Central Areas
features.description: The image preview feature works across multiple Business Central areas including agents, emails, and custom extensions.
